ZZ2009C is a specific medical procedure code representing the preparation of a nutrition plan ("Udarbejdelse af ernæringsplan") within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. It is primarily significant in the context of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] (AKDB), where it has been identified as a point of failure in regional data registration and quality monitoring [^src1]. 

According to regional feedback from Region Nordjylland, the clinical activity 'ernæringsplan' (nutrition plan) in the NordEPJ electronic health record system is not properly linked to the procedure codes ZZ2009C and [[zz2009d|ZZ2009D]] [^src1]. This technical infrastructure disconnect prevents the correct harvesting of data into the AKDB, directly supporting Regionshospital Nordjylland's claims regarding registration challenges for indicator 7 [^src1]. This issue highlights broader systemic difficulties in aligning local EHR workflows with national quality measurement databases in Danish acute surgery, where technical limitations threaten the validity of indicator results [^src1].

Additionally, the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (steering committee) has been involved in resolving coding issues related to nutrition plans, having received a proposal or status request in 2023 regarding the use of related nutrition codes [^src1].
